⌋
In situations when a single diagnostic request can result in more than one security
event, the Diagnostic Server Instance can report more than one security event.
Example: The diagnostic service 0x2E (WriteDataByIdentifier) as rejected
with NRC 0x33 (SecurityAccessDenied) and the DM is configured to report
SEV_UDS_SECURITY_ACCESS_NEEDED and SEV_UDS_WRITE_DATA_FAILED.
In this case the two security events SEV_UDS_SECURITY_ACCESS_NEEDED and
SEV_UDS_WRITE_DATA_FAILED are reported.
[SWS_DM_02015] Reporting security access denied to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service request is not allowed in the current security level, which results
in a negative response with NRC 0x33 (securityAccessDenied), the DM shall report a
security event SEV_UDS_SECURITY_ACCESS_NEEDED to IdsM (see [26] and table
[SWS_DM_02016]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02016].
